query_text: Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the top 8 countries by sampled innovations per visible ranked city in the 2020 report, where the metric is `total sampled innovations / number of entries in city_rankings`, values are expressed as sampled innovations per visible ranked city, countries must have at least one visible city in `city_rankings`, countries with `city_rankings = unavailable` are excluded, and bars are sorted from highest to lowest.
value_unit: sampled innovations per visible ranked city
